# Robert Koch

> Personal site of Robert Koch, an engineer, speaker and guitarist based in Melbourne, Australia. He is a Forward Deployed Engineer at Quarterzip AI, and the site covers his projects, research, conference talks and writing.

Robert previously worked at Redactive AI (semantic security for enterprise AI, acquired by Recordpoint), Amazon Web Services (Cloud Architect, public sector) and Localz (last-mile delivery software). He graduated from Monash University in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Maths, and served on the national committee of Young Engineers Australia through 2025.

## About and contact

- [Home](https://me.kochie.io): Introduction, contact links, selected work, research, talks and recent writing on one page

## Research

- [Optimising Neural Networks for Embedded Systems](https://me.kochie.io/research/neural-networks): Final year thesis project on speeding up image-classification networks by quantising activation functions to binary and ternary states, with a purpose-built TensorFlow library (`pyNet`) and benchmarks against AlexNet, VGG and Inception
- [Thesis report (PDF)](https://me.kochie.io/Optimising_Neural_Networks_for_Embedded_Systems.pdf)
- [Thesis poster (PDF)](https://me.kochie.io/Optimising_Neural_Networks_for_Embedded_Systems_Poster.pdf)
- [Project video](https://youtu.be/Vpi2-mYYwT8)
- [Source code](https://bitbucket.org/kochie/fyp)

## Talks

Listed newest first.

- One word was churning our customers (upcoming): Lessons from building a forward deployed engineering team at a startup
- [AI Agents That Don't Suck](https://me.kochie.io/AI_Agents_That_Dont_Suck.pdf) (NDC Sydney, 30 April 2026): A practical framework for building AI agents that deliver measurable business value. [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_vaIfRXXiIY)
- [AI Data Security Risks](https://me.kochie.io/AI_Data_Security_Risks.pdf) (Programmable, 18 March 2025): Security risks that generative AI introduces to enterprise data, and how to defend against them
- [What We Learnt Building Our AI Product](https://me.kochie.io/What_We_Learnt_Building_Our_AI_Product.pdf) (DDD By Night, 11 September 2024): Taking an AI product from prototype to customers. [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YeH90OBy_cM)
- Building secure RAG pipelines: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines for AI agents, up to multi-modal pipelines with enterprise security requirements
- Python, But Fast: A practical playbook for profiling, vectorising, batching and compiling hot paths
- Space to Cloud: Building AI pipelines from free satellite data using cloud ground stations

## Selected work

- [MetaFixer](https://metafixer.kochie.io): Adds missing metadata to photos exported from Facebook so they import with the correct date and location
- [Touch Typer](https://touch-typer.kochie.io): Open-source typing tutor for Linux, Windows and macOS
- [Contact Tracing](https://ct.vercel.app): Contact-tracing demonstration built on the AWS Cloud Development Kit
- [Particlez](https://3body.vercel.app): Real-time n-body particle simulator for the web
- [Stonks](https://stonks.kochie.io): Trading platform for crypto-currencies
- [benchtop-js](https://github.com/BenchTop/benchtop-js): Benchmarking tool for JavaScript projects
- [Space](https://kochie.space): Small web app that follows the mouse
